notes.title: v1.42.00 - Gamepad + Steam Deck improvements
notes.content:
- if you use a gamepad, then switch to a mouse, the gamepad cursor will disappear now
- on-screen keyboard if entering text via a gamepad implemented
- multiple gamepads supported (so you can switch mid-game)
- game launches in full-screen mode on Steam Deck
- other miscellaneous improvements

notes.title: v1.40.00 - Mangan at Draw / Nagashi Mangan
notes.content:
I've wanted to add support for this particular winning condition for a while. Please note that you need to enable support for it in the Settings if you want to play with it as a possibility.

Some minor bug-fixes/tweaks too. :)

Happy new year, everyone. Thanks for playing.

notes.title: v1.38.00 - Introducing Gamepad Support
notes.content:
Initial support for gamepads. Right stick scrolls dialog boxes and chooses characters; left stick + D-pad moves the cursor. "A" button selects, "B" goes back. Shoulder buttons will swap between tabs in certain dialogs.

You may need to adjust your Steam controller settings for this game to use a gamepad instead of mouse controls.

This is the first release with gamepad support, so some things may be a bit wonky... hopefully not too much though. ;)  Hope you enjoy.

notes.title: 1.36.00 - Shadows and bug-fixes
notes.content: 3D view has some extra lighting effects now; I've also made some small fixes relating to the fly-out menu that was interfering with the Tutorials and Replay functions.

notes.title: v1.35.03 - Discard Speed Setting, Auto-Ron, and Ignore Claims settings
notes.content:
Hi all.
This new version brings with it:
- a setting to adjust the speed at which the AI will discard tiles (offline only).
- a fly-out menu during gameplay that lets you auto-declare "Ron", or turn off prompts to claim for Chi/Pon/Kan.

Thanks again for your support. :)

notes.title: v1.28.50 - Small Scoring Fix
notes.content: - "After a Kong" could incorrectly stack with "Under the Sea" (last tile in wall). Fixed now.

notes.title: v1.28 - Bug tweaks and a scoring adjustment
notes.content:
- fixed a bug where a computer opponent could claim Ron on "Under the Sea" while being temporarily furiten.
- Blessing of Man / Renho now scores 5 Han, and is exclusive (other yaku and dora do not count), as per EMA rules.

Thanks again for the support. :)

notes.title: v1.27.00
notes.content:
Just an update to enable a new Setting for "Abortive Draws" (ie. restart a hand on 4 Riichis, 9 disconnected terminals, 4 kans by different users, or 4 of the same wind being discarded at the start of a hand).

Thanks all for your support. :)

notes.title: v1.24.00 - Fixes issues with North/Bonus tiles + certain yaku in Sanma (3P) mode
notes.content:
Claiming a North tile as a bonus in Sanma mode now correctly negates Blessings & Double Riichi (on first turn) and One-Shot yaku.

Thanks for your support. :)

notes.title: v1.23.70
notes.content:
Adds 'star' indications above tiles that, if discarded, would put you one tile away from a complete hand. (NB: Only shows if you have "Show Waits" enabled).

Also fixes an issue where the landscape mode wouldn't take effect if your Windows Display "Scaling" factor was set to something higher than 100%.

A few other bug fixes too.

Thanks for your support. :)

notes.title: 1.23.50 - Cloud Saves Implemented
notes.content:
Finally figured out how to do this. :)  So now you can start a game on one PC, then continue from another. :)

Also fixed a bug with Ippatsu counting even if someone claimed a North/Bonus tile in Sanma mode, or promoted a Pon to a Kan.

notes.title: v1.23 - "Show Waits" functionality added
notes.content:
You should now see a small box showing tiles that would complete your hand, and the number of each that are still "in play", when you're one tile away from a complete hand.

You still need to ensure you have a Yaku! :)

Also some other small tweaks/bug-fixes.

Thanks, as always, for your support.

notes.title: v1.22.00 - Bug fixes / tweaks
notes.content:
Hi all. Not much here, just a couple bug fixes for some edge-cases I found in 3-player/sanma mode.
Hope you're all doing well. :)

notes.title: v1.20.00
notes.content:
* Arabic Translation added. :)
* Various bug fixes and tweaks.

notes.title: v1.18.00 - Replays mode added
notes.content:
* Replays of matches added. (5 most recent matches will be logged; you can set individual matches to save indefinitely if you like).
* Bug fixes and tweaks

notes.title: v1.17.20
notes.content:
* if playing with "End on Negative Scores", CPU/player will no longer be allowed to declare Riichi if they have less than 1000 points.
* Portuguese language tweaks
* minor bugs/tweaks

notes.title: v1.17.02
notes.content:
* Portuguese translation added - thanks to Cardigan for contributing!
* Bug fixes / tweaks

notes.title: v1.16.04 - Minor bugfix release
notes.content: Fixes a problem with claiming a concealed Kong/Kan after declaring riichi.
Fixes a bug with the "Pure Straight" yaku that could occur if you have all three chis already exposed and try to go out on a pair.

notes.title: v1.15.08 (Bug fixes)
notes.content: Fixes a bug related to Furiten in sanma mode, and when one can claim a concealed kan after declaring Riichi. Also a minor text update to one of the tutorials. :)

notes.title: 1.15.03 (Minor Update)
notes.content: Sanma/3P mode - winning on a replacement tile now awards Rinshan ("After a Kan"... which isn't the best name for the yaku in English!).

notes.title: v1.15 - Japanese Voices Pack
notes.content:
I thought it'd be nice to add Japanese voices as an option, so... that's there now. :)
Of course, you can keep the English voices too, or disable voices entirely.

There's also a few small bug fixes.

Hope you enjoy. :)

notes.title: v1.14.11 - bug fixes, tweaks
notes.content:
* Han/Fan text fix in pop-ups when clicking on a Yaku name in the score summary panel
* Fix to online play sometimes starting with a blank screen
Corrects a problem with joining an online match with 3 or 4 players. Sorry for the issue!

notes.title: v1.14.08
notes.content: Fixes a bug that was preventing data from being saved correctly in some instances. Sorry for the problem!
Small bug-fix for "Random" selection in character select screen sometimes creating "invisible" opponents. 8)

notes.title: v1.14.05 - Sanma (3-player) mode added!
notes.content:
* 3-player (Sanma) mode added (swipe left when choosing opponents)
* Stats and Settings panels updated
* Bug fixes and tweaks

I hope you enjoy, and thanks again for your support. :)

notes.title: Update for Aug 22
notes.content: Fixed a bug in scoring ("3 Kongs" could have been scored in certain instances with just 2 kongs...).
* Can now double-click a tile to discard it.

* Translations for Achievements updated - all supported languages now accounted for.
* Japanese terms on Stats panel and hand summary panel adjustments.
* Various bug fixes and tweaks.

notes.title: v1.12.00
notes.content: Fixes some AI and server-related issues.

notes.title: Translations Update
notes.content: * Translations added for the various Achievements (still to do: Japanese, German, and Polish...)
